target.title: chore(deps): refresh toolchain
target.body:
## Summary

- refresh the mature TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Node type, and pnpm toolchain versions
- keep package, CI, benchmark, coverage, and Crabbox hydration pnpm pins current
- resolve the TypeScript compiler through its declared package binary so prepack works with TypeScript 7 exports

## Impact

No public API or runtime filesystem behavior change. Package preparation remains deterministic and now supports the current TypeScript compiler layout.

## Validation

- exact pnpm 10.34.5 frozen install
- `actionlint`
- `pnpm check`: 421 passed, 3 skipped
- security suite: 59 passed
- coverage, docs build, audit with zero vulnerabilities
- packed-install validation across all 19 exports and filesystem containment failures
- structured review: no actionable findings

## Real package proof

Redacted terminal output from the exact PR candidate:

```text
$ pnpm exec tsc --version
Version 7.0.2

$ pnpm dlx pnpm@10.34.5 pack --out /tmp/fs-safe.tgz
> @openclaw/fs-safe@0.4.1 prepack
> node scripts/prepack-build.mjs
@openclaw/fs-safe 0.4.1 packed successfully

$ pnpm add /tmp/fs-safe.tgz
+ @openclaw/fs-safe 0.4.1

$ node validate.mjs
overall_behavior=satisfies_contract
entry_points_imported=19
valid_round_trip=true
traversal=outside-workspace
absolute_path=outside-workspace
symlink_read=symlink
symlink_write=path-alias
hardlink_read=hardlink
create_no_clobber=already-exists
denied_mutation=denied-path
read_size_limit=too-large
outside_content_unchanged=true
valid_state_persists_after_failures=true
```
